title: I Left the Footrest Photo on the Desk They Rolled to the Corner

parts.text: I taped the footrest photo at 9:12 a.m. on the desk they rolled to the corner. The tag said ASSET 441 STAYS WITH THE BAY. I was thirty-one, analyst, standing in a bay that made me look like I owned the tilt. Facilities lead Nia said corners were atmosphere. I photographed the tag, the empty bay, and 441 under her monitor. Then I left the still where the rest had been. Nia laughed until assets asked for the photo. The rest rolled back. Nia asset-dates the bay now. A tag is only a tag until someone treats it like a clock.
